name: Abhishek Mathur
player_statement:
A complete player, Abhishek Mathur has made a big mark in cricket. With 223 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 41*, with an average of 10.05 and a quick strike rate of 104.44. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 121 sixes and 64 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 320.3 overs, taking 95 wickets at an economy rate of 7.75. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
